joint_list.note: Current Hadash/Ta'al/Balad alliance maps to the form's Hadash-Ta'al slot; user accepted proceeding after the distinction was explained. Not a historical identity or organizer-confirmed interpretation.

religious_zionism_zehut.note: Current poll alliance uses the form's Religious Zionism slot; preserve the combined source label. Not a split of seats between constituent parties.

other_qualifying_lists_rule: Unmapped individual lists may enter the combined field only through their reported allocated seats. Never apply a threshold to pooled other votes.
unreported_fields_rule: Infer residual zero seats only after a source is explicitly audited as a complete allocation and its reported seats sum to 120. Missing percentage measurements stay missing.
